{{Short description|German mathematician, editor of ZbMath (1942 – 2024)}}
{{use dmy dates|date=May 2024}}
'''Bernd Wegner''' (11 February 1942 – 18 January 2024) was a German mathematician.  He was the editor-in-chief of [[Zentralblatt für Mathematik]] from 1974 until 2011.

==Education and career==
Wegner was born on 11 February 1942, in [[Berlin]].<ref name="berlinerobit">{{cite web|url=https://www.math.berlin/nachrufe/bernd-wegner.html|title=Bernd Wegner (1942 - 2024) |publisher=Berliner Mathematische Gesellschaft e.V.|last1=Kühnel|first1=Wolfgang|last2=Ninnemann|first2=Olaf|access-date=28 May 2024}}</ref>  He attended high school at the Humboldt Gymnasium in Berlin.<ref name="berlinerobit"/>  He then attended the [[Technische Universität Berlin]], receiving his diploma in 1966.<ref name="berlinerobit"/>  He stayed at Technische Universität Berlin for his PhD, which he completed in 1970 under the direction of Kurt Leichtweiß, with a dissertation titled ''Beiträge zur Differentialgeometrie transnormaler Mannigfaltigeiten''.<ref>{{MathGenealogy|19785}}</ref>  He spent the remainder of his career at Technische Universität Berlin, retiring in 2007.<ref name="berlinerobit"/>

Wegner became editor-in-chief of [[Zentralblatt für Mathematik]] (later zbMATH Open) in 1974, taking over from [[Ulrich Güntzer]].<ref name="leibnitzobit">{{cite web|url=https://www.fiz-karlsruhe.de/en/nachricht/prof-dr-bernd-wegner-am-18-januar-2024-im-alter-von-81-jahren-verstorben|title= Prof. Dr. Bernd Wegner passed away on January 18, 2024 at the age of 81|date=25 January 2024|publisher=Leibnitz Institute for Information Infrastructure|access-date=28 May 2024}}</ref><ref name="zbMathAbout">{{cite web|url=https://zbmath.org/about/|title= About zbMATH |work=zbMATH Open|access-date=28 May 2024}}</ref>  His tenure as editor encompassed the separation of [[East Germany]] from zbMath, the reunification of East and West Germany, and the transition of zbMath from a paper resource to a digital resource.<ref name="leibnitzobit"/><ref name="zbMathAbout"/><ref>{{cite magazine|url=https://euromathsoc.org/magazine/articles/58|title= The “Jahrbuch über die Fortschritte der Mathematik” as a part of zbMATH Open |last=Teschke|first=Olaf|magazine=EMS Magazine|publisher=[[European Mathematical Society]]|access-date=28 May 2024}}</ref> While editor-in-chief, Wegner also helped to set up procedures for maintenance of the [[Mathematics Subject Classification]].<ref>{{cite book|first=Silke | last=Göbel|chapter = Glimpses into the history of Zentralblatt MATH|pages=1–16 |editor1-last=Teschke |editor1-first= O.|editor2-first= Bernd|editor2-last= Wegner|editor3-first=Dirk|editor3-last= Werner
| title=80 years of Zentralblatt MATH| year=2011 |publisher=Springer-Verlag|location=Heidelberg|isbn=978-3-642-21171-3|doi=10.1007/978-3-642-21172-0_1}}</ref>  He stepped down in 2011, and was succeeded by [[Gert-Martin Greuel]].<ref name="leibnitzobit"/>

==Personal life==
Wegner died on 18 January 2024, following a fall.<ref name="berlinerobit"/><ref name="leibnitzobit"/>
